notablePrerequisites: Market Festival attached to a basic land you control.
description:
Activate the basic land with Market Festival attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {1}{G/U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic land.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.
